name: band bent over lat pulldown
description: Hinge forward and pull a band down toward your hips, like a lat pulldown from a bent over position. It trains the lats and the muscles between your shoulder blades.
instructions: Anchor the band high and hold it with both hands, arms extended.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull the band down toward your hips, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom for a moment.
Let the band rise slowly until your arms are straight again.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.
